signature: SUBROUTINE ZPPEQU( UPLO, N, AP, S, SCOND, AMAX, INFO )

params.name: uplo
params.reference:
-   `= 'U'`: Upper triangle of A is stored;
-   `= 'L'`: Lower triangle of A is stored.

params.name: N
params.reference: The order of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: AP
params.reference: The upper or lower triangle of the Hermitian matrix A, packed columnwise in a linear array. The j-th column of A is stored in the array `AP` as follows: if `UPLO = 'U'`, `AP(i + (j-1)*j/2) = A(i,j)` for $1 \le i \le j$; if `UPLO = 'L'`, `AP(i + (j-1)*(2n-j)/2) = A(i,j)` for $j \le i \le n$.

params.name: s
params.reference: If `INFO = 0`, S contains the scale factors for A.

params.name: scond
params.reference: If `INFO = 0`, S contains the ratio of the smallest `S(i)` to the largest `S(i)`. If $\mathrm{SCOND} \ge 0.1$ and `AMAX` is neither too large nor too small, it is not worth scaling by S.

params.name: amax
params.reference: Absolute value of largest matrix element. If `AMAX` is very close to overflow or very close to underflow, the matrix should be scaled.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value
-   `> 0`: if `INFO = i`, the i-th diagonal element is nonpositive.
